Container.Name: Precious
Container.Overview: A collection manager for the whole household: books, games, records, anything. Define your own data sources (REST, GraphQL or web pages) to search for items, fill in their details and keep values like prices up to date. Runs as one container with its own PostgreSQL database; everything lives in the appdata folder.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port Precious is served on.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: The database, uploaded covers, backups and the app secret. Back this folder up.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: The address people open Precious at (an https:// address behind a reverse proxy makes it installable as an app and enables barcode scanning). Other addresses of the same server work too.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: For scheduled lookups and the nightly backup, e.g. Europe/Madrid.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns the files in the data folder.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns the files in the data folder.

Config.Name: Backups kept
Config.Description: How many nightly database backups to keep in the data folder's backups directory.

Config.Name: Backup time
Config.Description: When the nightly backup runs (24-hour time).

Config.Name: Behind a reverse proxy
Config.Description: Set to true when Precious sits behind a reverse proxy (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, Traefik), so sign-in limits apply per visitor.

Config.Name: External database
Config.Description: Optional. A postgres:// address to use your own PostgreSQL instead of the bundled one, which then stays off.

Config.Name: App secret
Config.Description: Optional. Generated on first start and kept in the data folder; set it only to manage it yourself (64 hex characters).
